title: Chamber Spotlight
text: Chamber Spotlight From Staff Reports Sep 10, 2025 7 hrs ago 0 1 min to read Facebook Twitter WhatsApp SMS Email FSPT is located at 240 Washington Street in Ravenswood. Submitted photo Facebook Twitter WhatsApp SMS Email Print Copy article link Save The Jackson County Chamber of Commerce will feature a member business each month.Each will share information about products or services, interesting facts or history and general information.Business Name: First Settlement Physical Therapy Address/Contact: 240 Washington Street, Ravenswood, WV 26164; Kecia Barr kecia.barr@fsptmail.comHours: Monday-Friday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.Telephone: 304-273-8071 Website: www.fspt.org/ravenswoodWhat type of business is First Settlement Physical Therapy?Depending on the location we have Physical/Occupational/Speech Therapy, Dry Needling, Women’s Health, Pediatric Therapy, Aquatic Therapy, and Hand Therapy just to name a few. Share your history and growth:(FSPT) is a family owned and operated physical, occupational, and speech therapy company! We prioritize affordable care and a family atmosphere. Established in 2000 in Marietta, OH, the historic first settlement of the Northwest Territory, our name reflects our deep roots in the community. FSPT is owned by Hema Hargus and her son Simon Hargus. Hema’s husband, Phil Hargus, and daughter in law, Lisa Hargus, along with an extremely well trained staff, help run FSPT to make it West Virginia and Ohio’s most trusted therapy provider. In the 25 years that FSPt has been in business we have grown to 48 clinics and 300 employees. You must be logged in to react. Click any reaction to login.
